title: A thorium-229 optical nuclear clock with feedback loop
summary_zh: 研究提出了一种基于钍-229的光学核钟，采用吸收光谱快速反馈稳定激光。实验表明，该核钟对外部干扰具有更强的鲁棒性，并提高了物理原理测试的灵敏度。
summary_en: This study proposes a thorium-229 optical nuclear clock stabilized by a laser using absorption spectroscopy. Experiments show the clock's robustness against external disturbances and enhanced sensitivity in fundamental physics tests.
insights: 创新点：首次实现基于钍-229的光学核钟
方法亮点：采用吸收光谱快速反馈稳定激光
关键发现：核钟对外部干扰具有更强的鲁棒性
insights_en: Novelty: First realization of a thorium-229 optical nuclear clock
Method highlight: Stabilizing laser with rapid feedback based on absorption spectroscopy
Key finding: Enhanced robustness against external disturbances
abstract: Abstract The laser-accessible nuclear transition in the thorium-229 isotope has been identified as a candidate for realizing an optical nuclear clock 1 that might outperform current optical clocks based on electron-shell transitions in atoms or ions 2 . It is expected to be more robust against external perturbations 3,4 and to provide enhanced sensitivity in clock-based tests of the fundamental principles of physics 5,6 . Here we realize a thorium-229 nuclear clock by stabilizing a continuous-wave laser to the 148-nm nuclear transition with rapid feedback based on absorption spectroscopy 7 . The thorium-229 nuclei are embedded in a millimetre-sized, room-temperature calcium fluoride crystal. A subharmonic of the 148-nm radiation is continuously compared with a Yb + single-ion clock. The nuclear clock shows a shot-noise-limited fractional frequency instability of $$3\times 1{0}^{-12}/\sqrt{\tau /{\rm{s}}}$$ 3 × 1 0 − 12 / τ / s where τ is the averaging time, approaching 10 −15 instabilities over 1 day of operation. Improvements to the instability by several orders of magnitude are projected for future devices. We use the nuclear clock to constrain models of ultralight dark matter by searching for periodic fluctuations and slow drifts in the nuclear transition energy, on timescales between 20 s and 1 day. Benefitting from the enhanced sensitivity of the thorium-229 transition, these constraints compete with the best atomic clocks concerning dark matter coupling to photons and go beyond previous measurements regarding coupling to the strong force.

title: A nuclear clock synchronized to 229Th
summary_zh: 本文展示了同步于钍-229的核钟，通过稳定148.4 nm真空紫外激光实现。实验表明，该核钟具有紧凑、鲁棒的特点，适用于基础物理测试。
summary_en: This paper demonstrates a 229Th nuclear clock stabilized by a 148.4 nm vacuum-ultraviolet laser. Experiments show the clock's compactness, robustness, and suitability for fundamental physics tests.
insights: 创新点：实现同步于钍-229的核钟
方法亮点：采用148.4 nm真空紫外激光稳定核钟
关键发现：核钟适用于基础物理测试
insights_en: Novelty: Realization of a 229Th nuclear clock
Method highlight: Stabilizing the clock with a 148.4 nm vacuum-ultraviolet laser
Key finding: Suitability of the clock for fundamental physics tests
abstract: Abstract Atomic clocks have made time and frequency the most precisely measured quantities in physics, progressing from microwave standards that realize the SI second 1 to optical clocks with unprecedented precision 2 . A nuclear clock transfers the frequency reference from an electronic to a nuclear transition and the uniquely low-lying, laser-accessible, isomeric transition in 229 Th currently offers the most practical route to compact, robust timekeeping and sensitive tests of fundamental physics 3–8 . Realizing such a clock requires turning spectroscopy of the 229 Th nuclear resonance 9–17 into a stable discriminator for steering a traceable oscillator. Here we demonstrate a 229 Th nuclear clock by stabilizing a continuous-wave, narrow-linewidth 148.4 nm vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) laser 18 to a resolved, weakly temperature-sensitive nuclear transition 17,19 in 229 Th:CaF 2 crystals 20–22 . A 10-μW VUV source generated by four-wave mixing in cadmium vapour 18,23,24 and phototube-based frequency modulation absorption readout provide a fast, high-signal-to-noise nuclear discriminator. The clock reaches a fractional frequency instability of $$5\times 1{0}^{-13}/\sqrt{\tau /{\rm{s}}}$$ 5 × 1 0 − 13 / τ / s for averaging time τ . Clock-transition frequencies measured in two independently fabricated crystals agree at the 10 −13 level and are consistent with previous VUV-comb measurements on other 229 Th:CaF 2 crystals 17 . These results establish laser-addressed nuclei as operational clock references and provide a reproducible solid-state platform for compact nuclear clocks, nuclear quantum sensors and precision tests of fundamental physics.

title: A Bregman Proximal Viewpoint on Neural Operators
summary_zh: 提出从Bregman正则化优化问题的角度研究神经算子。方法将激活算子视为Bregman邻近算子。结果显示，Bregman神经算子具有与标准神经算子相同的表达能力。
summary_en: This paper presents a Bregman Proximal Viewpoint on neural operators, viewing activation operators as Bregman proximity operators. Results show that Bregman neural operators have the same expressivity as standard neural operators.
insights: 创新点：提出Bregman正则化优化问题的神经算子新视角
方法亮点：将激活算子视为Bregman邻近算子
关键发现：Bregman神经算子具有与标准神经算子相同的表达能力
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a new viewpoint on neural operators from Bregman regularized optimization problems
Method highlight: Interpreting activation operators as Bregman proximity operators
Key finding: Bregman neural operators have the same expressivity as standard neural operators
abstract: We present several advances on neural operators by viewing the action of operator layers as the minimizers of Bregman regularized optimization problems over Banach function spaces. The proposed framework allows interpreting the activation operators as Bregman proximity operators from dual to primal space. This novel viewpoint is general enough to recover classical neural operators as well as a new variant, coined Bregman neural operators, which includes the inverse activation operator and features the same expressivity of standard neural operators. Numerical experiments support the added benefits of the Bregman variant of Fourier neural operators for training deeper and more accurate models.

title: Spin-adapted neural network wavefunctions in real space
summary_zh: 提出SAAM方法，确保空间波函数的反对称性。NNQMC中应用，捕捉电子关联。物理先验嵌入神经网络，提高系统表示。
summary_en: Introduce SAAM to ensure antisymmetry in real-space wavefunctions. Apply in NNQMC to capture electron correlation. Embed physical priors into neural networks for improved system representation.
insights: 创新点：SAAM方法确保反对称性
方法亮点：NNQMC中应用电子关联
关键发现：物理先验提高系统表示
insights_en: Novelty: SAAM ensures antisymmetry
Method highlight: Application in NNQMC for electron correlation
Key finding: Physical priors improve system representation
abstract: Spin plays a fundamental role in understanding electronic structure, yet many real-space wavefunction methods fail to adequately consider it. We introduce the Spin-Adapted Antisymmetrization Method (SAAM), a general procedure that enforces exact total spin symmetry for antisymmetric many-electron wavefunctions in real space. In the context of neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo (NNQMC), SAAM leverages the expressiveness of deep neural networks to capture electron correlation while enforcing exact spin adaptation via group representation theory. This framework provides a principled route to embed physical priors into otherwise black-box neural network wavefunctions, yielding a compact representation of correlated system with neural network orbitals. Compared with existing treatments of spin in NNQMC, SAAM is more accurate and efficient, achieving exact spin purity without any additional tunable hyperparameters. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we apply SAAM to study the spin ladder of iron-sulfur clusters, a long-standing challenge for many-body methods due to their dense spectrum of nearly degenerate spin states. Our results reveal accurate resolution of low-lying spin states and spin gaps in [Fe$_2$S$_2$] and [Fe$_4$S$_4$] clusters, offering new insights into their electronic structures. In sum, these findings establish SAAM as a robust, hyperparameter-free standard for spin-adapted NNQMC, particularly for strongly correlated systems.

title: System design of the Ultra Mobility Vehicle: A driving, balancing, and jumping bicycle robot
summary_zh: 设计了一种结合自行车和反作用质量的机器人平台，实现动态运动。方法采用模拟驱动的优化过程，并使用深度强化学习框架展示多种运动行为的零样本迁移。
summary_en: This paper presents the system design of the Ultra Mobility Vehicle, a robot that combines a bicycle and a reaction mass for dynamic movement. The method uses a simulation-driven optimization process and demonstrates zero-shot transfer of diverse athletic behaviors using a deep reinforcement learning framework.
insights: 创新点：设计了一种新型动态运动机器人平台
方法亮点：结合自行车和反作用质量实现动态运动
关键发现：深度强化学习实现多种运动行为的零样本迁移
insights_en: Novelty: Designs a novel dynamic movement robot platform
Method highlight: Combining bicycle and reaction mass for dynamic movement
Key finding: Deep reinforcement learning achieves zero-shot transfer of diverse athletic behaviors
abstract: Trials cyclists and mountain bike riders can hop, jump, balance, and drive on one or both wheels. This versatility allows them to achieve speed and energy efficiency on smooth terrain and agility over rough terrain. Inspired by these athletes, we present the design and control of a robotic platform, Ultra Mobility Vehicle (UMV), that combines a bicycle and a reaction mass to move dynamically with minimal actuated degrees of freedom. We used a simulation-driven design optimization process to synthesize a spatial linkage topology with a focus on vertical jump height and momentum-based balancing on a single wheel contact. Using a deep reinforcement learning (RL) framework, we demonstrate zero-shot transfer of diverse athletic behaviors, including track stands, jumps, wheelies, rear-wheel hopping, and front flips. This 23.5-kilogram robot is capable of high speeds ( v max = 8 meters per second) and jumping on and over large obstacles (1-meter tall or 130% of the robot’s nominal height).

title: Hearing the shape of an arena with spectral swarm robotics
_topics: spectral swarm robotics and spatial context understanding
summary_zh: 研究提出光谱群机器人框架，通过局部交互恢复群体几何结构的全局谱描述符。机器人模拟扩散估计拉普拉斯谱不变量，作为环境紧凑描述符。实验验证了该方法的可行性。
summary_en: This study introduces a spectral swarm robotics framework that allows robots to recover global spectral descriptors of the swarm's geometric structure through local interactions. Robots emulate diffusion to locally estimate Laplacian spectral invariants, which serve as compact descriptors of the environment. Experiments validate the feasibility of this method.
insights: 创新点：光谱群机器人框架实现全局几何结构描述
方法亮点：局部交互估计拉普拉斯谱不变量
关键发现：实验验证了方法的可行性
insights_en: Novelty: A spectral swarm robotics framework for global geometric structure description
Method highlight: Estimating Laplacian spectral invariants through local interactions
Key finding: The feasibility of the method validated by experiments
abstract: Swarm robotics relies on robots with minimal sensing and computation that achieve self-organization at the level of the collective to address a variety of tasks. Yet, swarm robotics still struggles with global tasks that require understanding the broader spatial context in which robots operate, such as identifying the shape of the arena in which they are embedded. Here, we introduce spectral swarm robotics, a framework in which robots recover global spectral descriptors of the swarm’s geometric structure through strictly local interactions. To do so, robots emulate diffusion to locally estimate Laplacian spectral invariants, quantities normally obtained only through centralized computation. These spectral values serve as compact descriptors of the environment. In the present proof of concept, robots estimated the second Laplacian eigenvalue, λ 2 , and used it to classify arenas from a predefined set of shapes with distinct spectral signatures. We show that estimating a single eigenvalue is sufficient for one-shot classification among selected confined environments with distinct spectral signatures. We uncovered a scaling law linking swarm size (a global parameter) and interaction radius (a local parameter) that ensures robust estimation. We validated the approach experimentally on two distinct hardware platforms, Kilobots and Pogobots, achieving reliable classification of arena shapes under realistic noise and sparse connectivity conditions. Last, we discuss how locally recovering Laplacian spectral invariants opens avenues for swarm robotics in settings where producing efficient collective behaviors strongly depends on the global structure of the swarm.

title: Force-driven single-molecule transformations through tip-mediated stabilization of transition states
summary_zh: 研究利用机械力驱动单分子反应，通过原子力显微镜诱导结构变化，实现能量低于活化能的净能量成本。
summary_en: This study utilizes mechanical forces to drive single-molecule reactions, achieving a net energy cost below the activation energy by using atomic force microscopy to induce structural changes.
insights: 创新点：机械力驱动单分子反应实现低能量成本
方法亮点：原子力显微镜诱导结构变化
关键发现：单分子反应能量低于活化能
insights_en: Novelty: Mechanical force-driven single-molecule reactions with low energy cost
Method highlight: Structural changes induced by atomic force microscopy
Key finding: Single-molecule reactions with energy below the activation energy
abstract: Abstract Mechanochemistry uses mechanical forces to drive chemical transformations, offering an energy-efficient alternative to traditional thermal, optical, or electrical reaction pathways. At the single-molecule scale, controlling structural changes with mechanical stimuli is fundamental for developing nanoscale devices and understanding chemical reactivity. In conventional single-molecule reactions driven by light or electrical currents, energy is supplied through one-way excitation processes, requiring the single-event energy input to exceed the activation energy barrier. Here we show that mechanically driven single-molecule reactions can bypass this limitation, proceeding with a net energy cost below the activation energy. By using atomic force microscopy to induce the structural inversion of individual, bowl-shaped sumanene molecules on a gold surface, we measure the mechanical energy spent during the transformation. The net energy cost is significantly lower than the theoretical activation energy. This sub-barrier reaction occurs because attractive van der Waals forces from the mesoscopic tip body stabilize the transition state more effectively than the final state. Our findings demonstrate a distinct energetic mechanism in mechanochemistry, highlighting alternative strategies for energy-efficient molecular manipulation.

title: Formation of a swelling gel underlies a morphological transition in Bacillus subtilis biofilms
summary_zh: 本文研究枯草杆菌生物膜中凝胶形成的过程。发现通过调整聚合物组成，生物膜驱动凝胶形成，并展示两种聚合物的互补作用。
summary_en: This paper studies the process of gel formation in Bacillus subtilis biofilms. It is found that by adjusting the polymer composition, biofilms drive gel formation, and the complementary roles of two polymers are demonstrated.
insights: 创新点：发现生物膜通过聚合物组成驱动凝胶形成
方法亮点：使用成像和流变学测量
关键发现：两种聚合物的互补作用
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of biofilms driving gel formation through polymer composition
Method highlight: Using imaging and rheological measurements
Key finding: Complementary roles of two polymers
abstract: Microbes across diverse species and environments form biofilms, living materials composed of cells and extracellular polymers. Biofilm-dwelling cells benefit from emergent soft matter physics, which sculpts three-dimensional morphologies and facilitates osmotic nutrient uptake. Although biofilms are modeled as viscoelastic gels, the physical origins of the phase transition underlying their conversion from groups of cells to living gels have not been systematically investigated. Here, we show that Bacillus subtilis biofilms use polymer composition to tune their physical properties and drive gel formation. Using imaging, water immersion experiments, and rheological measurements with matrix knockout strains, we demonstrate the complementary roles of two polymers in this developmental transition: hydrophilic poly- γ -glutamic acid swells colonies by absorbing water while exopolysaccharides serve as effective cross-linkers, causing a sol–gel-like phase transition that imparts structural integrity. With matrix knockout coculture biofilms, we independently modulate the production of each polymer and reveal a phase space of biofilm morphologies. Colonies that produce both polymers develop macroscopic wrinkles. A thin-film model predicts biofilm wrinkling from swelling-induced internal strain coupled with elasticity. The model reproduces the shape of our observed morphological phase diagram. Our results demonstrate that bacteria leverage gelation to vary their material properties and morphologies, with implications for microbial ecology and engineering living matter.

title: Physics-informed single-frame end-to-end learning for denoising and background removal in fluorescence imaging
summary_zh: 提出基于物理信息的端到端学习框架，通过模拟生成训练数据集，实现荧光图像去噪和背景消除。
summary_en: A physics-informed end-to-end learning framework is proposed to enable denoising and background suppression from a single fluorescence image, generating training datasets entirely through simulation.
insights: 创新点：引入物理信息提高去噪效果。
方法亮点：通过模拟生成训练数据集。
关键发现：框架在多种生物样本中有效。
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces physics information to enhance denoising performance.
Method highlight: Generates training datasets through simulation.
Key finding: The framework is effective across structurally distinct biological samples.
abstract: Fluorescence microscopy is often limited by low signal-to-noise ratios arising from the finite number of detected photons and by an out-of-focus background that obscures structural details. Here, we introduce a physics-informed end-to-end learning framework that enables denoising and background suppression from a single fluorescence image. By integrating a microscope-parameterized forward model, the proposed framework generates realistic training datasets entirely through simulation, eliminating the need for experimentally acquired ground-truth images. Once trained for a given imaging condition, the deep neural network can be deployed directly to previously unseen biological specimens without specimen-specific retraining, as demonstrated across the structurally distinct biological samples examined in this study. We experimentally validate the robust single-frame denoising performance in both wide-field and confocal fluorescence microscopy. The enhanced photon efficiency further enables superresolution optical fluctuation imaging using only tens of frames, substantially improving temporal resolution while preserving spatial fidelity. In addition, the proposed single-frame end-to-end learning framework can be extended to remove out-of-focus background in thick samples. These results establish physics-guided, simulation-based end-to-end learning as a general and practical strategy for rapid, data-efficient fluorescence image restoration under photon-limited conditions.

title: Mechanotherapy enhances nanodrug uptake by overcoming the actin cytoskeleton damping effect
summary_zh: 研究显示，通过克服肌动蛋白细胞骨架阻尼效应，机械疗法可增强纳米药物摄取。
summary_en: The study shows that mechanotherapy can enhance nanodrug uptake by overcoming the actin cytoskeleton damping effect.
insights: 创新点：发现机械疗法可增强纳米药物摄取。
方法亮点：研究肌动蛋白细胞骨架在纳米药物摄取中的作用。
关键发现：肌动蛋白细胞骨架阻尼效应抑制纳米药物摄取。
insights_en: Novelty: Found that mechanotherapy can enhance nanodrug uptake.
Method highlight: Investigated the role of actin cytoskeleton in nanodrug uptake.
Key finding: Actin cytoskeleton damping effect inhibits nanodrug uptake.
abstract: Efficient nanodrug therapy in solid tumors is limited not only by extracellular barriers but also by the mechanical state of the plasma membrane (PM). Although mechanotherapy remodels the extracellular matrix (ECM) and improves tissue-level delivery, its effect on transmembrane transport remains unclear. Here, we show that matrix stiffness is transmitted to the PM through the actomyosin cytoskeleton and thereby regulates nanoparticle (NP) uptake. Within a hepatocellular carcinoma-relevant stiffness range, matrix stiffening promoted excessive F-actin polymerization and stress-fiber formation, producing a mechanically damped PM–actin interface that resisted membrane deformation and suppressed NP uptake. Pharmacological and genetic perturbations indicated that this mechanical barrier was reversible. In vivo, β-aminopropionitrile-mediated tumor softening loosened ECM architecture, increased NP penetration, and promoted cellular uptake by reducing F-actin-associated mechanical resistance. Intratumoral spatial analyses and paired bilateral tumor experiments further supported local regulation of NP uptake by the actomyosin state under matched matrix conditions. Combined tumor softening and donafenib-loaded PLGA NPs reduced endpoint tumor weight by 87.8% relative to free donafenib but increased pulmonary metastasis, revealing a potential efficacy-safety trade-off. These findings identify a multiscale mechanical mechanism linking tumor-matrix mechanics to nanomedicine delivery and the PM–actin interface as a potential therapeutic target.

title: High-fidelity entangling gates and nonlocal circuits with neutral atoms
summary_zh: 使用中性原子量子处理器实现高保真纠缠门和非局域电路。
summary_en: A neutral-atom quantum processor is used to realize high-fidelity entangling gates and nonlocal circuits.
insights: 创新点：实现高保真纠缠门，提高量子电路性能
方法亮点：使用平滑幅度脉冲和快速校准
关键发现：非局域电路性能稳定
insights_en: Novelty: Realizing high-fidelity entangling gates to improve quantum circuit performance
Method highlight: Using smooth amplitude pulses and fast calibration
Key finding: Stable performance of nonlocal circuits
abstract: The generation and manipulation of entanglement with low error are essential in quantum information systems. In practice, two-qubit entangling gates constitute a dominant error source, limiting circuit depths and performance in fault-tolerant architectures. Using a neutral-atom quantum processor, we realized entangling controlled- Z gates with a high-Rabi-frequency smooth-amplitude pulse, employing state-selective readout and qubit reuse for fast calibration, and achieved a fidelity of 99.854(4)%, which improved to 99.941(3)% upon loss postselection, with stable performance for 10 hours. We then used these low-error gates in quantum circuits with coherent atom rearrangement. Performance was benchmarked by creating and disentangling cluster states, and subsequently, we studied nonlocally entangled states with scrambling circuits featuring longer-range connectivity. Our approach provides a route toward deep-circuit, efficient fault-tolerant quantum computation.

title: Volatile eutectics to tailor crystallization for perovskite optoelectronics
summary_zh: 本研究通过利用锌溴化物和甲基铵氯化物的共晶相互作用来调控钙钛矿晶体生长。实验表明，该方法提高了薄膜的光致发光量子产率和载流子寿命。最终，太阳能电池效率达到26.5%。
summary_en: This study utilizes the eutectic interaction between zinc bromide and methylammonium chloride to tailor perovskite crystallization. Experiments show this method improves the photoluminescence quantum yield and carrier lifetime of the films, leading to a solar cell efficiency of 26.5%.
insights: 创新点：利用共晶相互作用调控钙钛矿晶体生长
方法亮点：提高薄膜性能，增强太阳能电池效率
关键发现：共晶相互作用导致晶体结构优化，提高光电性能
insights_en: Novelty: Utilizing eutectic interaction to control perovskite crystallization
Method highlight: Improving film performance and enhancing solar cell efficiency
Key finding: Eutectic interaction leads to optimized crystal structure, improving photonic performance
abstract: Improvements to the radiative efficiency of halide perovskite thin films are necessary to approach fundamental solar cell performance limits. We tailored perovskite crystallization by leveraging the eutectic interaction between zinc bromide and methylammonium chloride additives. The resulting films had high photoluminescence quantum yield and charge carrier decay times and low surface recombination velocity. Nanoprobe x-ray microscopy revealed local melting of the eutectic at grain boundaries during annealing that reduced intragranular structural defect density. Annealing also homogenized the halide distribution and caused zinc segregation to grain boundaries. Solar cells fabricated with the volatile eutectic reached 26.5% power conversion efficiency (PCE, certified 25.9%), and perovskite minimodules (areas more than 15 square centimeters) had 23.9% PCE. Small-area cells with a poly[bis(4-phenyl)(2,4,6-trimethylphenyl)amine] hole transporter retained 85.8% of their initial 24.1% PCE after 1400 hours of continuous operation at 85°C. Furthermore, this approach enables 26.1% external quantum efficiency as light-emitting diodes.

title: Wafer-scale low-symmetry graphene moiré superlattice for integrated quantum rectifiers
summary_zh: 本研究通过表面预熔工程在锗110上制备低对称性石墨烯超晶格。实验表明，这种材料具有非线性霍尔电导率。
summary_en: This study creates wafer-scale low-symmetry graphene moiré superlattices on germanium-110 using surface premelting engineering. Experiments show the material exhibits nonlinear Hall conductivity.
insights: 创新点：表面预熔工程制备低对称性石墨烯超晶格
方法亮点：利用低对称性材料实现非线性霍尔电导
关键发现：低对称性石墨烯超晶格的非线性霍尔电导特性
insights_en: Novelty: Surface premelting engineering for creating low-symmetry graphene moiré superlattices
Method highlight: Utilizing low-symmetry materials for nonlinear Hall conductivity
Key finding: Nonlinear Hall conductivity characteristics of low-symmetry graphene moiré superlattices
abstract: Low-symmetry materials unlock rich Berry curvature physics and anomalous transport phenomena that are forbidden in high-symmetry quantum systems through rigorous crystalline symmetry constraints. Current approaches rely on external fields or complex heterogeneous stacking to break crystalline symmetries, which hinders scalable device integration. In this work, we demonstrate surface premelting engineering to create wafer-scale low-symmetry graphene on germanium-110 [Ge(110)]. Controlled premelting forms striped germanium surface patterns that reduce graphene symmetry from D 6h to C 1v , producing a room-temperature nonlinear Hall conductivity of ~11 micrometers per volt per ohm. First-principles calculations attribute this to originating from overtilted massive Dirac cones of hybridized germanium bands and the graphene Dirac cone. Integrated nonlinear Hall rectifiers generate >20 millivolts of output from radio frequency input and drive commercial voltage boosters and light-emitting diodes, establishing a complementary metal-oxide semiconductor–compatible route toward wafer-scale nonlinear quantum devices.

title: Marine snow viscosity regulates microbial degradation and the ocean carbon sink
summary_zh: 研究海洋雪的粘度对微生物降解和海洋碳汇的影响。使用分子旋转器测量粘度场。发现粘度影响降解速度和沉降深度。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of marine snow viscosity on microbial degradation and the ocean carbon sink. Molecular rotors are used to measure the nanoscale viscosity field. It is found that viscosity affects degradation rate and sinking depth.
insights: 创新点：发现粘度影响海洋碳循环
方法亮点：使用分子旋转器测量粘度场
关键发现：粘度与降解速度和沉降深度相关
insights_en: Novelty: Discovers that viscosity affects ocean carbon cycle
Method highlight: Uses molecular rotors to measure viscosity field
Key finding: Viscosity is related to degradation rate and sinking depth
abstract: Bacterial degradation of marine snow aggregates is a major component of global carbon cycling. Whether aggregate carbon is released in the upper ocean or is sequestered at depth depends on its sinking speed and degradation rate. However, little is known about the physical constraints of bacterial colonization and degradation of individual aggregates. Using molecular rotors to measure the nanoscale viscosity field of natural aggregates, we show that aggregates are highly structured microhabitats with less-viscous regions that are accessible for colonization and more-viscous regions that correlate to a barrier to bacterial infiltration. By quantifying the viscosity degradation rate, we demonstrate that more viscous aggregates take longer to degrade, sink farther, and contribute more to carbon sequestration, revealing a microscale physical constraint of the global ocean carbon pump.

title: AutoHMD: Scalable and Accurate Validation of Antibody–Antigen Complexes by Heated Molecular Dynamics
summary_zh: 研究评估了加热分子动力学（HMD）在抗体-抗原复合物验证中的应用。该方法通过热扰动下的结构稳定性来区分结合构象。
summary_en: This study evaluates the application of heated molecular dynamics (HMD) in validating antibody-antigen complexes. The method discriminates binding conformations based on structural stability under thermal perturbation.
insights: 创新点：评估HMD在抗体-抗原复合物验证中的应用
方法亮点：通过热扰动下的结构稳定性区分结合构象
关键发现：HMD有效区分结合构象
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the application of HMD in validating antibody-antigen complexes
Method highlight: Discriminates binding conformations based on structural stability under thermal perturbation
Key finding: HMD effectively discriminates binding conformations
abstract: MOTIVATION: Antibody-antigen (Ab-Ag) interactions are central to immune recognition and widely exploited in therapeutic design, making accurate structural characterization of these complexes a central challenge in the field. While docking and artificial intelligence-based approaches can generate multiple candidate binding modes, reliably identifying near-native conformations represent a key bottleneck. Existing methods depend largely on static scoring functions, which fail to capture the dynamic nature of Ab-Ag interfaces and, as a result, offer limited power to discriminate between competing poses. RESULTS: Here, we evaluate heated molecular dynamics (HMD) as a strategy to discriminate binding pose quality based on structural stability under thermal perturbation, implemented through the automated workflow AutoHMD. Across a diverse set of Ab-Ag complexes, HMD enabled clear separation between high-quality and incorrect poses. During simulations, near-native complexes maintained a stable interface, whereas incorrect ones showed progressive divergence, particularly at elevated temperatures. Interaction analysis revealed that high-quality poses maintain more stable and persistent interfacial contacts throughout the simulations. In contrast, incorrect poses display an unstable interaction network. Additional simulation replicates increased classification consistency, while a mean iRMSD cutoff of approximately 2.5 Å achieved 90% accuracy in cross-validation and retained robust performance on an independent external set. Its transfer to Boltz-2-generated complexes further supported the broader applicability of HMD to AI-predicted binding poses. Overall, AutoHMD provides a reproducible, scalable, and high-throughput framework for validation of predicted antibody-antigen complexes, with potential applications in structural bioinformatics and biopharmaceutical design. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online. The AutoHMD workflow scripts are available on GitHub at https://github.com/SFBBGroup/AutoHMD. The version used in this study is permanently archived in Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22757672. All simulation and structural data supporting this study are publicly available in Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20722229; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22750139; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20707612.

title: Improved assessment of Alaskan Arctic coastal wave exposure accounting for landfast ice
summary_zh: 结合陆地冰数据，提高阿拉斯加北极海岸波浪暴露评估。模拟结果显示季节性波浪暴露差异明显。
summary_en: Improved assessment of Alaskan Arctic coastal wave exposure by accounting for landfast ice. Simulation results show stark contrasts in seasonal wave exposure.
insights: 创新点：考虑陆地冰数据
方法亮点：提高波浪暴露评估
关键发现：季节性波浪暴露差异明显
insights_en: Novelty: Accounting for landfast ice data
Method highlight: Improved wave exposure assessment
Key finding: Significant differences in seasonal wave exposure
abstract: Simulations of the ocean wave climate are critical for assessment of coastal processes and hazards in observation sparse regions such as the Arctic. While the multidecade wind and ice datasets necessary for driving long-term wave simulations have proven reliable for such efforts, the presence of landfast ice along shorelines at scales not represented by these data has been a persistent uncertainty impeding accurate analysis of impacts to Arctic coasts. Here, we explore this uncertainty by producing a historical high-resolution wave simulation and combining simulation outputs with landfast ice data for the Alaskan Arctic. The resulting dataset yields an improved assessment of coastal waves and identifies stark contrasts in the seasonal wave exposure of the Chukchi and Beaufort regions. Notably, analysis shows that absent supplemented landfast ice, coastal ice cover is broadly underestimated by 10 to 25 d, resulting in wave energy being overestimated by 5 to 10% in shallow depths nearshore. Notably, these figures can reach up to 70 d of underestimation for ice cover and 48% overestimation of wave energy in certain locations. The persistent overestimation and potential for extreme positive biases in coastal wave assessment highlight the need for representation of landfast ice in Arctic coastal analysis efforts and our analysis reveals the spatial and temporal biases for related research.

title: Multiyear dual-isotope fingerprinting at South Asian receptor sites constrains carbon monoxide sources and enhanced oxidation
summary_zh: 研究量化了南亚受体站点CO来源和排放-汇动态。燃烧和大气氧化是主要来源。
summary_en: This study quantifies CO source contributions and emission-sink dynamics at South Asian receptor sites, with combustion and atmospheric oxidation as the main sources.
insights: 创新点：量化CO来源和排放-汇动态
方法亮点：应用双同位素指纹技术
关键发现：燃烧和大气氧化为主要来源
insights_en: Novelty: Quantification of CO source contributions and emission-sink dynamics
Method highlight: Application of dual-isotope fingerprinting technology
Key finding: Combustion and atmospheric oxidation as the main sources
abstract: Carbon monoxide (CO) is an indirect short-lived climate forcer with uncertainties both in sources and its role in atmospheric oxidation. Based on nine winter-long dual-isotope campaigns at two South Asian receptor sites intercepting the continental outflow, we quantified CO source contributions and emission–sink dynamics. Combustion accounts for 68 to 74% of South Asia regional CO (including 34 to 37% from biomass burning) with secondary atmospheric oxidation contributing 26 to 32% (dominated by oxidation of nonmethane volatile organic compounds (NMVOCs) at 21 to 26%, with methane oxidation contributing 5.5 to 6.4%). These isotope-observational constraints suggest a twice higher role for atmospheric oxidation than in model estimates. Spatially, the absolute contributions of both primary and secondary CO decrease from the Indo-Gangetic Plain to the northern Indian Ocean, while the relative contribution of oxidation-derived CO increases, indicating enhanced secondary CO production near source regions. Observation-model comparison suggests that transport from the continental areas dominates CO over adjacent oceanic regions, with minor local production. During the COVID-19 emission perturbation, combustion-derived CO fell sharply in absolute terms, NMVOC-derived CO rose, and CH 4 -derived CO remained stable, providing an observational constraint on the sensitivity of atmospheric oxidation to emission changes. Our results reveal a significant contribution of CO from atmospheric oxidation in South Asia, calling for a reassessment of regional emission–oxidation coupling in models and of mitigation strategies.

title: Multi-AI agent framework reveals the “oxide gatekeeper” in aluminum nanoparticle oxidation
summary_zh: 研究利用多智能体框架揭示铝纳米粒子氧化的原子机制。
summary_en: This study uses a multi-agent framework to reveal the atomic mechanism of aluminum nanoparticle oxidation.
insights: 创新点：多智能体框架应用于材料科学，揭示氧化机制
方法亮点：结合机器学习，提高模型准确性
关键发现：揭示“氧化物门控”机制
insights_en: Novelty: Application of multi-agent framework in materials science to reveal oxidation mechanism
Method highlight: Combination with machine learning to improve model accuracy
Key finding: Revealing the 'oxide gatekeeper' mechanism
abstract: Aluminum nanoparticles (ANPs) are among the most energy-dense solid fuels, yet the atomic mechanisms governing their transition from passivated particles to highly reactive states remain elusive. This stems from a fundamental computational bottleneck: Ab initio methods offer quantum-level fidelity but are restricted to small spatiotemporal scales (<500 atoms, picoseconds), while empirical force fields lack the reactive fidelity required for complex combustion environments. Here, we bridge this gap by employing a human-audited, multiagent framework to make the development and validation of a task-specific machine learning potential (MLP) more traceable and auditable. The workflow coordinates active learning, model evaluation, validation evidence, and human expert review, while leaving scientific interpretation and model-use decisions under researcher control. This collaborative cycle ensures quantum mechanical accuracy while exhibiting near-linear scalability. Strikingly, our simulations reveal a temperature-regulated dual-mode oxidation mechanism: At moderate temperatures, the oxide shell acts as a dynamic “gatekeeper,” regulating oxidation through a “breathing mode” of transient nanochannels; above a critical threshold, a “rupture mode” leads to shell failure and rapid combustion. Importantly, we resolve a decades-old controversy by demonstrating that aluminum cation outward diffusion, rather than oxygen transport, dominates mass transfer in studied regimes, with diffusion coefficients consistently exceeding those of oxygen by 2 to 3 orders of magnitude. These results provide an atomistic framework for interpreting ANP reactivity and illustrate how human-audited agentic workflows can make domain-specific reactive MLP development and deployment more reproducible.

title: A neural operator framework for data-driven discovery of stability and receptivity in physical systems
summary_zh: 研究引入了数据驱动的框架，无需已知方程即可自动识别物理系统的稳定性和响应性。
summary_en: The research introduces a data-driven framework that can automatically identify the stability and receptivity of physical systems without requiring known equations.
insights: 创新点：提出数据驱动的稳定性分析框架。
方法亮点：无需方程即可分析非线性系统。
关键发现：提高非线性系统分析的准确性。
insights_en: Novelty: A data-driven stability analysis framework is proposed.
Method highlight: Analyzing nonlinear systems without equations.
Key finding: Improving the accuracy of nonlinear system analysis.
abstract: Understanding how complex systems respond to perturbations, such as whether they will remain stable or what their most sensitive patterns are, is a fundamental challenge across science and engineering. Traditional stability and receptivity (resolvent) analyses are powerful but rely on known equations and linearization, limiting their use in nonlinear or poorly modeled systems. Here, we introduce a data-driven framework that automatically identifies stability properties of both equilibrium points and periodic orbits, as well as optimal forcing responses from observation data alone, without requiring governing equations. By training a neural network as a dynamics emulator and using automatic differentiation to extract its Jacobian, we can perform stability and receptivity analyses directly from data. We demonstrate the method on systems of increasing complexity, from canonical models to high-dimensional fluid flows and a real-world climate dataset, employing model reduction where needed and successfully identifying dominant instability modes and optimal input–output structures, even in strongly nonlinear regimes. By leveraging a neural network emulator, we readily obtain a nonlinear representation of system dynamics while additionally retrieving intricate dynamical patterns that were previously difficult to resolve. This equation-free methodology establishes a broadly applicable tool for analyzing complex, high-dimensional datasets, with potential relevance to grand challenges in fields such as climate science, neuroscience, and fluid engineering.

title: Physical origins of speed control in swimming fishes
summary_zh: 研究推导了鱼类游泳速度与尾拍频率之间的关系，解释了速度控制背后的物理机制。
summary_en: The study derives a relationship between fish swimming speed and tail-beat frequency, explaining the physical mechanism behind speed control.
insights: 创新点：推导了速度与尾拍频率的关系。
方法亮点：结合流体力学原理分析。
关键发现：揭示了速度控制的物理起源。
insights_en: Novelty: A relationship between speed and tail-beat frequency is derived.
Method highlight: Analyzing using fluid mechanics principles.
Key finding: The physical origin of speed control is revealed.
abstract: The linear relationship between tail-beat frequency and swimming speed in fish, first described by Bainbridge in 1958, has since been confirmed in species as disparate as eels and tuna. Dimensional scaling has explained why linearity should emerge at high Reynolds numbers, but the frequency–speed relationship itself has remained empirical, with no physical framework describing its behavior across swimming regimes, and no account of what sets the two quantities that define it: the distance covered per tail beat and the frequency below which forward motion supposedly ceases. Here, we derive a relationship from a balance of fin thrust, generated by a leading-edge vortex, and drag due to the boundary layer on the body. This framework yields an explicit expression for speed in terms of midline kinematics and body morphology. This formulation shows that the maximum stride length is set by the undulatory wavelength and the tail-beat phase offset, rather than by the conventional scaling metric of body length, and that no minimum frequency is required for forward motion. The model reproduces kinematic measurements from freely swimming glass catfish, published simulations, and Bainbridge’s original data. Without recalibration, it predicts the results of independent simulations spanning wide variations in wavelength, phase offset, and morphology to within ten percent. Linear scaling is thus one asymptotic limit of a more general propulsive relationship linking morphology and body-wave kinematics to swimming speed in fishes and bioinspired vehicles, where the body waveform, rather than the actuation frequency, emerges as the variable that sets performance.

title: Magnetically guided programmable thermomechanical protection enabled by biomimetic asymmetric design
summary_zh: 仿生不对称设计实现磁引导可编程热机械保护，提高材料机械可调性。
summary_en: Biomimetic asymmetric design enables magnetically guided programmable thermomechanical protection, enhancing material mechanical tunability.
insights: 仿生不对称设计
磁引导可编程保护
材料机械可调性提升
insights_en: Biomimetic asymmetric design
Magnetic guided programmable protection
Improved material mechanical tunability
abstract: Precision instruments operating in harsh environments require protective materials that can dissipate impact energy while resisting heat. However, actively tunable thermomechanical protection under coupled multiphysics conditions remains challenging. Inspired by shellfish and echinoderms, here we show that an asymmetrically engineered shear-stiffening gel (SSG) yields a Janus magnetorheological elastomer whose two faces mimic the brick-and-mortar architecture of shellfish and the impact-hardening behavior of echinoderms, respectively. Unlike single-modification anti-creep strategies of SSG that degrade shear-stiffening or severely increase initial modulus, our design achieves a 40-fold mechanical tunability, with the storage modulus ranging from 11.29 to 450.28 kPa, arising from the synergistic enhancement of strain-rate-dependent stiffening and magnetic interactions. The integration of magnetic and optical functions enables semiactive noncontact 2D-to-3D protection, achieving an 85% reduction in impact force and a 40 °C temperature difference via bidirectional photothermal regulation, demonstrating competitive thermomechanical protection performance. Furthermore, this strategy establishes a magnetically guided programmable pathway for thermomechanical protection and provides a generalizable blueprint for multifunctional intelligent materials, advancing protective technologies for outdoor equipment operating in extreme environments involving coupled physical fields.

title: Mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation driven by energetic-particle irradiation of icy solids
summary_zh: 研究发现，能量粒子照射冰质固体可产生质量无关的氧同位素分馏。
summary_en: The study finds that energetic particle irradiation of icy solids can produce mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation.
insights: 创新点：揭示了能量粒子照射冰质固体产生质量无关氧同位素分馏的现象
方法亮点：实验室实验研究低温下的同位素分馏
关键发现：能量粒子照射导致同位素分馏
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the phenomenon of mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation induced by energetic particle irradiation of icy solids
Method highlight: Laboratory study of isotope fractionation at low temperatures
Key finding: Energetic particle irradiation leads to isotope fractionation
abstract: Mass-independent isotope fractionation (MIF) of oxygen provides key insights into atmospheric chemistry and the origin of isotopic anomalies in planetary materials. To date, MIF has been primarily associated with gas-phase processes involving symmetry-dependent reaction pathways, most notably ozone formation. Whether analogous effects can arise in condensed phases or at interfaces remains an open question. Here we report laboratory experiments demonstrating that energetic particle irradiation of icy oxide surfaces produces mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation at temperatures as low as 10 K. Electron irradiation of SiO 2 and Al 2 O 3 substrates in the presence of H 2 O ice results in measurable shifts in Δ 17 O in the underlying solids. The resulting three-isotope relationships include slope-1-like behavior in SiO 2 and Al 2 O 3 and distinct, substrate-dependent trends in Al 2 O 3 , indicating that irradiation-induced defect formation and interfacial chemistry govern the isotope effects. The magnitude of the observed anomalies demonstrates that irradiation-driven processes can generate substantial oxygen isotope heterogeneity in condensed phases. These results identify a previously unrecognized class of MIF and provide a quantitative framework for interpreting oxygen isotope signatures in radiation-processed environments, including interstellar grains and early solar system materials.

title: In-cloud motions shape warm-rain production in marine clouds: Evidence from multiyear observations
summary_zh: 多年观测揭示海洋云中云内运动对暖雨形成的影响。
summary_en: Multiyear observations reveal the impact of in-cloud motions on warm-rain production in marine clouds.
insights: 创新点：云内运动对暖雨形成的影响
方法亮点：多年海洋区域观测数据
关键发现：云层性质对暖雨的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Impact of in-cloud motions on warm-rain formation
Method highlight: Multiyear observations across oceanic regions
Key finding: Influence of cloud regime properties on warm precipitation
abstract: Despite years of research, the processes controlling warm-rain formation remain uncertain. Leveraging multiple years of observations collected across four oceanic regions, we systematically reassess the properties of precipitation just beneath cloud base. The observations show that warm-rain characteristics are remarkably consistent within cloud regimes yet differ substantially between stratocumulus and cumulus, indicating that cloud-regime properties exert a stronger influence on warm precipitation than regional environmental variability. Precipitation is observed beneath marine stratocumulus in over 56% of cloudy columns with liquid water path (LWP) <130 g m −2 , rising to more than 84% in columns with LWP beyond 130 g m −2 . This indicates that marine stratocumulus routinely support warm-rain formation and suggests that barriers to precipitation onset in this regime are weaker than commonly assumed. For the same LWP, oceanic cumulus precipitate less frequently than stratocumulus but on average produce two times larger and one to two orders of magnitude fewer precipitation drops. This contrast is consistent with cumulus presenting two times stronger updrafts and lower adiabaticity than stratocumulus, both of which can affect drop growth histories. Whereas the precipitation characteristics of stratocumulus are generally consistent with growth by collision–coalescence during gravitational free fall in low LWP clouds, those of cumulus cannot be explained without invoking additional processes. Together, these findings suggest that warm-precipitation parameterizations should more explicitly account for the influence of small-scale dynamical processes on precipitation growth. The apparent importance of drop growth histories further motivates continued exploration of Lagrangian particle-tracking approaches in both models and observations.

title: GrandTour: A legged robotics dataset in the wild for multi-modal perception and state estimation
summary_zh: 研究引入了GrandTour数据集，用于多模态感知和状态估计。数据集包含在复杂户外和室内环境中收集的腿部机器人数据。
summary_en: This study introduces the GrandTour dataset, a legged-robotics dataset for multi-modal perception and state estimation, collected across challenging outdoor and indoor environments.
insights: 创新点：引入GrandTour数据集用于多模态感知和状态估计
方法亮点：收集复杂户外和室内环境数据
关键发现：GrandTour数据集支持腿部机器人研究
insights_en: Novelty: The GrandTour dataset is introduced for multi-modal perception and state estimation
Method highlight: Data collected from challenging outdoor and indoor environments
Key finding: GrandTour dataset supports legged robot research
abstract: Accurate state estimation and multi-modal perception are prerequisites for autonomous legged robots in complex, large-scale environments. To date, no large-scale public legged-robot dataset captures the real-world conditions needed to develop and benchmark algorithms for legged-robot state estimation, perception, and navigation. To address this, we introduce the GrandTour dataset, a multi-modal legged-robotics dataset collected across challenging outdoor and indoor environments, featuring an ANYbotics ANYmal-D quadruped equipped with the Boxi multi-modal sensor payload. GrandTour spans a broad range of environments and operational scenarios across distinct test sites, from alpine scenery and forests to demolished buildings and urban areas, and covers a wide variation in scale, complexity, illumination, and weather conditions. The dataset provides time-synchronized sensor data from spinning LiDARs, multiple RGB cameras with complementary characteristics, proprioceptive sensors, six ANYmal-mounted Intel RealSense D435i depth cameras, and the ZED2i stereo RGB-D camera. Moreover, it includes high-precision ground-truth trajectories from satellite-based RTK-GNSS and a Leica Geosystems total station. This dataset supports research in SLAM, high-precision state estimation, and multi-modal learning, enabling rigorous evaluation and development of new approaches to sensor fusion in legged robotic systems. With its extensive scope, GrandTour represents the largest open-access legged-robotics dataset to date. The dataset is available at https://grand-tour.leggedrobotics.com , on HuggingFace (ROS-independent), and in ROS formats, along with tools and demo resources.

title: Volitional control of wearable robots
summary_zh: 文章提出通过解码脊髓运动神经元活动和肌肉力量信息来实现对可穿戴机器人的意愿控制。
summary_en: The article proposes voluntary control of wearable robots through decoding spinal motor neuron activity and resulting muscle force information.
insights: 创新点：开发人机接口以控制可穿戴机器人。
方法亮点：解码脊髓运动神经元活动。
关键发现：实现肌肉行为般的机器人控制。
insights_en: Novelty: Developing a human-machine interface for controlling wearable robots.
Method highlight: Decoding spinal motor neuron activity.
Key finding: Achieving robot control with muscle-like behavior.
abstract: This Comment motivates the development of human–machine interfaces that decode spinal motor neuron activity and resulting muscle force information in moving humans. Such interfaces could enable users across the neuromuscular functional spectrum to volitionally control wearable robots with muscle-like behaviour.

title: Bulk mesophases modeling of ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals
summary_zh: 研究通过结合屈电性、弹性、体排列和极化-向列耦合来建模铁电向列液晶的体相介观相。
summary_en: The study models the bulk mesophases of ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals by combining flexoelectricity, elasticity, bulk ordering, and polarization-nematic couplings.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种新的FNLCs体相介观相模型。
方法亮点：结合多种物理机制进行建模。
关键发现：预测和解释了FNLCs的结构。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a new model for the bulk mesophases of FNLCs.
Method highlight: Combines multiple physical mechanisms for modeling.
Key finding: Predicts and explains the structure of FNLCs.
abstract: Abstract Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs) are emerging materials that combine orientational order with spontaneous macroscopic polarization. They exhibit distinctive properties, such as polar domain formation, field-tunable textures, and strong electro-elastic couplings. However, due to the complexity of the underlying mechanisms, the bulk structure of the emergent mesophases is not yet fully understood, and a generalized description of all observed phases is still lacking. Here, we demonstrate the bulk mesophases of FNLCs as stabilized by a combination of flexoelectricity, elasticity, bulk ordering, and polarization-nematic couplings. Specifically, we develop Landau de-Gennes-like free energy framework that predicts and explains the structure of major experimentally observed ferroelectric nematic phases, including ferroelectric nematic, antiferroelectric splay nematic, apolar nematic, and isotropic phase, notably together with the correct phase transition sequences. Additionally, we predict the possible existence of new bend-instability-driven mesophase characterized by periodic splay-bend structure. Finally, we calculate a complete phase diagram of bulk ferroelectric nematics as dependent on the key coupling mechanisms, which could possibly enable the predictive design and applications of these novel emergent ferroelectric nematic materials.

title: Monolithic three-dimensionally integrated memristor-thin-film transistor for electrically programmable multimode reservoir computing
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种垂直和单片集成的Ru/HfO2/TiN忆阻器与In2O3沟道薄膜晶体管，实现电可编程多模态水库计算。
summary_en: The study develops a vertically and monolithically integrated Ru/HfO2/TiN memristor with In2O3 channel thin-film transistors for electrically programmable multimode reservoir computing.
insights: 创新点：实现了电可编程水库计算。
方法亮点：垂直单片集成忆阻器和薄膜晶体管。
关键发现：扩展了时间响应范围。
insights_en: Novelty: Achieves electrically programmable reservoir computing.
Method highlight: Vertically monolithically integrates memristors and thin-film transistors.
Key finding: Extends the temporal response range.
abstract: Reservoir computing offers an efficient framework for processing temporal information, but most hardware reservoirs exhibit fixed or narrowly tunable dynamics determined by intrinsic material relaxation time. A monolithically integrated memristor-thin-film transistor reservoir kernel of this study enables electrically programmable temporal dynamics across a wide timescale. By vertically and monolithically integrating Ru/HfO2/TiN memristors with In2O3 channel thin-film transistors (TFTs), the memristive conductance dynamics are modulated by the TFTs. The temporal response can be actively tuned over three orders of magnitude experimentally and extended to over eight orders of magnitude via circuit configuration, demonstrating temporally unconstrained hardware with general applicability for spatiotemporal data processing. Implemented as an active reservoir array compatible with back-end-of-line integration, the system exhibits reliable spatiotemporal responses. The system demonstrates spatiotemporal computing capability through dynamic motion recognition in vision sensors and ultrasound signal classification, achieving high accuracy with a simple linear readout layer. Current reservoir computing hardware is efficient but limited by fixed dynamics. Shim et al. report a monolithically integrated memristor-transistor reservoir with electrically programmable temporal dynamics, supporting multiple temporal processing modes for motion recognition and biomedical signal classification.

title: The structural dynamics and molecular coupling in the slow inactivation of a prokaryotic voltage-gated sodium channel
summary_zh: 研究电压门控钠通道的慢失活机制，揭示构象状态和关键残基作用，实验表明L176和T206在失活过程中起关键作用。
summary_en: This study investigates the slow inactivation mechanism of a prokaryotic voltage-gated sodium channel, revealing conformational states and key residue functions, showing that L176 and T206 play critical roles in inactivation.
insights: 创新点：揭示慢失活过程中的构象状态
方法亮点：单分子FRET技术揭示分子耦合
关键发现：L176和T206在失活过程中起关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling conformational states in slow inactivation
Method highlight: Single-molecule FRET reveals molecular coupling
Key finding: L176 and T206 are critical in inactivation
abstract: Slow inactivation in voltage-gated sodium channels (Navs) is crucial for regulating cell excitability. Many studies indicate that the selectivity filter (SF) serves as the inactivation gate, but the structural mechanism and coupling between the distal primary and inactivation gates remain poorly understood. Our single-molecule FRET studies reveal that the NavAb SF transits among three conformational states, with depolarization enriching a high FRET state, potentially the slow inactivated conformation. We show L176 in the SF and T206 in the S6 helix as key residues that form a steric-hindrance coupler. Crystallographic analysis reveals that bulkier L176F overrides the opening tendency of an S6 C-terminal deletion (ΔC230) and closes the primary gate, while smaller T206A partially uncouples the slow inactivation gate. SmFRET data confirm that L176F restores the high FRET population depleted by ΔC230 or the open-pore blocker lidocaine. Our results indicate that ‘conformational talk’ through L176-T206 underlies slow inactivation in prokaryotic Navs. Slow inactivation of voltage-gated sodium channels is important for regulating cellular excitability. Here the authors probe the conformational dynamics in the selectivity filter using smFRET and reveal the critical residue pair that mediates conformational communication between the primary and slow inactivation gates

title: Near-atomistic simulations reveal the molecular principles that control chromatin structure and phase separation
summary_zh: 开发高精度粗粒化模型，模拟染色质结构，揭示组蛋白尾动态和相互作用网络，实验表明模型预测与实验结果一致。
summary_en: This study develops a high-precision coarse-grained model to simulate chromatin structure, revealing histone tail dynamics and interaction networks, showing that model predictions align with experimental results.
insights: 创新点：高精度粗粒化模型模拟染色质结构
方法亮点：解析组蛋白尾动态和相互作用网络
关键发现：模型预测与实验结果一致
insights_en: Novelty: High-precision coarse-grained model for chromatin structure simulation
Method highlight: Resolving histone tail dynamics and interaction networks
Key finding: Model predictions align with experimental results
abstract: Abstract Understanding how chromatin’s physicochemical properties shape its emergent organization is central to deciphering genome function. To address this, we present OpenCGChromatin, a high-performance coarse-grained model that achieves near-atomistic simulations of chromatin systems an order of magnitude larger than previously possible, spanning biomolecular condensates and fibers tens of kilobases in length. OpenCGChromatin simulations independently predict, from physicochemical principles, the linker-DNA-dependent chromatin structures observed by cryo-ET and the relative thermodynamic stability of condensates inferred from biochemical assays. Crucially, OpenCGChromatin resolves histone-tail dynamics and interaction networks that remain inaccessible experimentally, explaining how linker-DNA length controls histone tail accessibility and the resulting multiscale structure of chromatin condensates. Extending simulations to 108-nucleosome fibers shows that acetylation disrupts chromatin compaction in a pattern-specific manner by weakening key tail-mediated interactions, with H4K16 and H3K9 emerging as the most energetically disruptive modifications. These results position OpenCGChromatin as a powerful framework for linking molecular detail to emergent chromatin organization.

title: Anthropogenic aerosol reduction contributes to faster flash drought onset in a changing climate
summary_zh: 人为气溶胶减少导致快速干旱发生速度加快。气溶胶减少与土壤水分亏缺增加相关。气溶胶减少加剧了干旱发生速度的变异性。
summary_en: Anthropogenic aerosol reduction leads to faster onset of flash droughts in a changing climate. Aerosol reduction is increasingly linked to increased soil moisture deficits. Aerosol reduction intensifies variability in onset-speed.
insights: 创新点：气溶胶减少与快速干旱相关
方法亮点：多源观测和气候模拟
关键发现：气溶胶减少加剧干旱变异性
insights_en: Novelty: Aerosol reduction is associated with flash droughts
Method highlight: Multi-source observations and climate simulations
Key finding: Aerosol reduction intensifies drought variability
abstract: Flash droughts have emerged as severe hazards, posing growing challenges to natural and socioeconomic systems, yet the influence of recent aerosol reductions on their onset remains unclear. Here, we investigate the impacts of aerosols and their underlying mechanisms using multi-source observations and large-ensemble climate simulations. Lower aerosol levels are increasingly linked to severe soil moisture deficits, with aerosol effects on onset-speed variability intensifying across 69.2% of regions. During the onset stage, air temperature pathways associated with aerosol variability account for a larger fraction of onset-speed variability than pathways linked to atmospheric demand. Aerosols have long acted to dampen flash drought development; however, their reduction, acting within a warming climate, contributes to faster flash drought onset. As aerosol emissions decline in the future, the area at higher risk of flash drought acceleration in aerosol-forced simulations is projected to increase by 11.7% during 2070–2099 relative to the historical period of 1990–2019. Anthropogenic aerosol reduction contributes to faster flash drought onset by enhancing soil moisture depletion induced by higher temperature and increased shortwave radiation.

title: Prospects and complexities in sustainability impacts of global residue-based bioenergy deployment
summary_zh: 全球残留生物能源部署对可持续性的影响复杂。优化AFR利用可提高可持续性贡献。区域差异由AFR可用性和技术配置驱动。
summary_en: The sustainability impacts of global residue-based bioenergy deployment are complex. Optimizing AFR utilization can enhance sustainability contributions. Regional disparities are driven by AFR availability and technology configuration.
insights: 创新点：AFR利用优化可持续性
方法亮点：全球模型和生命周期评估
关键发现：区域差异由AFR驱动
insights_en: Novelty: AFR utilization optimization enhances sustainability
Method highlight: Global models and life cycle assessment
Key finding: Regional disparities driven by AFR
abstract: Amid rising global demand for sustainable energy, agricultural and forestry residues (AFRs) emerge as a key yet underutilized resource in energy transition. Mechanisms of how optimizing multipath AFR utilization advances sustainability contributions in varied socioeconomic contexts remain underexplored. Integrating the Global Change Analysis Model and life cycle assessment within an optimized Integrated AFR-to-Energy System (IAES) framework, we evaluate the selected Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)-related contributions of global IAES deployment across combined Shared Socioeconomic Pathways-Representative Concentration Pathways scenarios until 2060. Our results reveal that regional disparities in the contributions to SDGs are driven by variations in AFR availability, technology configurations, and socioeconomic conditions. Most lower-middle-to-low income regions struggle to achieve meaningful sustainability benefits. Canada, where energy output from IAES deployment could meet nearly 20% of its energy demand by 2060, leads the sustainability gains excelling in SDG7 and SDG13, followed by Eastern Europe that strides in SDG1, while China shows comparatively limited prospects. This study offers a comparative, scenario-based basis for informing bioenergy deployment strategies across regional contexts to advance energy transition and the SDGs. This study shows that deploying agricultural and forestry residue-based bioenergy globally could advance multiple Sustainable Development Goals, with benefits varying substantially by region and socioeconomic scenario.

title: High potential contribution of intercropping to soybean and maize self-sufficiency in Europe
summary_zh: 间作提高欧洲大豆和玉米自给自足潜力。间作可节省土地，提高产量。实现大豆自给自足可能需要大量间作。
summary_en: Intercropping has high potential for soybean and maize self-sufficiency in Europe. Intercropping saves land and increases yields. Achieving soybean self-sufficiency may require extensive intercropping.
insights: 创新点：间作提高自给自足潜力
方法亮点：模拟和土地节约
关键发现：间作提高产量和自给自足
insights_en: Novelty: Intercropping enhances self-sufficiency potential
Method highlight: Simulation and land-saving
Key finding: Intercropping increases yield and self-sufficiency
abstract: Abstract This study examines whether maize-soybean intercropping could improve the European Union’s soybean self-sufficiency while minimizing trade-offs with maize and other crops production. Assuming a four-year return, intercropping on 6.3, 13.1, and 20.1 Mha could produce 9.1 (28.8), 18.2 (63.7), and 27.2 (99.0) Mt of soybean (maize), achieving 25% (34%), 50% (75%), and 75% (116%) self-sufficiency. Reaching similar co-productions with sole crops require an additional 11.1, 24.7, and 36.5 Mha, implying 20−21% land savings with intercrops. Full soybean self-sufficiency could require more than 25 Mha of intercrops (23% of European cropland) annually. These estimates held under a large range of nitrogen inputs and temporal overlaps between crop species, provided 1 hectare of intercropping produced more soybean than 0.5 hectare of sole soybean. Geographic variation in sole crop yields should therefore be considered when assessing intercrops land-use efficiency. Our results highlight intercropping as a strategy to simultaneously improve European soybean production, satisfy maize needs, and save lands.

title: Environmentally Relevant Concentrations of Nanomaterials Drive Photochemical Production of Reactive Species and Pollutant Degradation in Surface Waters
summary_zh: 研究纳米材料在环境相关浓度下的光化学作用。发现TiO2纳米材料产生较高羟自由基。DOM与纳米材料混合表现出协同效应。
summary_en: Studies the photochemical role of nanomaterials at environmentally relevant concentrations. Finds that TiO2 nanomaterials produce higher hydroxyl radicals. DOM plus nanomaterial mixtures show synergistic behavior.
insights: 创新点：纳米材料在环境浓度下的光化学作用
方法亮点：量化TiO2纳米材料和DOM的反应中间体
关键发现：协同效应导致羟自由基形成增加
insights_en: Novelty: Photochemical role of nanomaterials at environmentally relevant concentrations
Method highlight: Quantification of reactive intermediates from TiO2 nanomaterials and DOM
Key finding: Synergistic effect leading to increased hydroxyl radical formation
abstract: Reactive intermediates in surface waters are widely attributed to dissolved organic matter (DOM). Natural, incidental, or engineered nanomaterials simultaneously occur at parts per billion and can function as photocatalysts, yet the photochemical role of nanomaterials at environmentally relevant concentrations remains overlooked in surface water photochemistry. Here, we quantify reactive intermediates from TiO2 nanomaterials (1–100 μg L−1) and DOM (1–5 mgC L−1) under 222, 265, and 365 nm. Despite lower concentrations relative to DOM, TiO2 produces hydroxyl radical (HO•) rates 10× to 100× higher per unit mass, resulting in comparable HO• formation. DOM plus nanomaterial mixtures shows synergistic behavior, with HO• formation 16-21% above additive predictions. DOM has limited impact in the degradation of 6PPD-quinone whereas nanomaterials enhanced its degradation due to elevated [HO•]ss. These results demonstrate nanomaterials can contribute to or exceed DOM in HO• driven micropollutant degradation in surface waters or engineered ultraviolet-light water treatment systems. Environmentally relevant nanomaterial concentrations can rival dissolved organic matter in driving pollutant transformation under sunlight or UV-based water treatment.

title: Topological diversity and scintillating dynamics of dipolar surface twists in a van der Waals magnet
summary_zh: 研究范德华磁体中偶极表面扭曲的拓扑多样性和动态。发现表面扭曲具有分数电荷。表面扭曲形成多样化结构。
summary_en: Studies the topological diversity and scintillating dynamics of dipolar surface twists in a van der Waals magnet. Finds that surface twists carry fractional charges. Surface twists assemble into diverse structures.
insights: 创新点：范德华磁体中表面扭曲的拓扑特性
方法亮点：三维域结构系统研究
关键发现：分数电荷表面扭曲形成多样化结构
insights_en: Novelty: Topological properties of surface twists in van der Waals magnets
Method highlight: Systematic investigation of three-dimensional domain architectures
Key finding: Fractional charge surface twists form diverse structures
abstract: Realizing diverse configurations and dynamics of skyrmionic solitons offers additional topological and dynamical degrees of freedom for energy-efficient, topology-based spintronic devices. Extending these solitons into three dimensions further amplifies their potential, enabling the selective exploitation of surface- or bulk-topological characteristics, a regime that remains largely unexplored. Here, we report high-density dipolar-interaction-stabilized surface twists atop bulk stripe domains under zero magnetic field, through a systematic investigation of three-dimensional domain architectures in the room-temperature van der Waals ferromagnet Fe3GaTe2. Unlike conventional skyrmions with integer topological charges, these surface twists carry fractional charges and assemble into diverse composite configurations under field swapping, including aggregates of up to 13 surface twists and ring-like structures. Current-driven experiments uncover two distinct dynamic modes: scintillation, marked by the nucleation, annihilation, and helicity switching of surface twists, and ordered motion of bulk skyrmion strings. These behaviors arise from the interplay between spin-transfer torque and local pinning, establishing surface twists as tunable surface-localized topological states whose dynamics are decoupled from their bulk counterparts, thereby enabling versatile hybrid spintronic functionalities. Authors investigate the field- and current-driven dynamics of three-dimensional magnetic textures in Fe3GaTe2, revealing topological diversity and distinct dynamical behaviors at the surface and in the bulk.

title: A cross-layer 2D photodetection framework for standardized readout and signal fusion
summary_zh: 提出二维光检测器的跨层框架。解决信息接口不匹配和系统延迟问题。实现物理响应到系统输出的转换。
summary_en: Proposes a cross-layer framework for 2D photodetectors. Addresses information interface mismatch and system delay issues. Establishes a conversion pathway from physical response to system output.
insights: 创新点：二维光检测器的跨层框架
方法亮点：集成缺陷机制分析和信号融合
关键发现：实现物理响应到系统输出的转换
insights_en: Novelty: Cross-layer framework for 2D photodetectors
Method highlight: Integration of defect-mechanism analysis and signal fusion
Key finding: Conversion from physical response to system output
abstract: Beyond improving device responsivity, a central challenge in photodetectors based on two-dimensional (2D) materials is to resolve the information-interface mismatch and delayed system translation caused by trap-governed persistent photoconductivity (PPC). Here we present a cross-layer engineering route oriented towards practical implementation that integrates defect-mechanism analysis, non-stationary signal definition, dynamic distortion compensation and readout-interface engineering, thereby establishing a conversion pathway from physical response to system output in 2D MoS2, WSe2 and PtSe2 photodetectors. In this context, drift, hysteresis and fatigue accumulation in time-varying photoresponses are no longer treated merely as non-ideal perturbations, but are reformulated as state-dependent information that can be defined, compensated and interfaced. Through interface restructuring and stable readout, nW-level state-dependent photocurrents are systematically mapped onto a mixed-signal readout interface. We further extend this strategy to array-level unified output and multisensor fusion, with its frequency-guided representation evaluated in a machine-vision task. Our results show that the history-dependent nonlinear response governed by PPC is not simply a local device non-ideality, but a state-encoded signal linking defect dynamics, readout pathways and system-level tasks. This work provides an engineering route for translating 2D photodetectors from device-level studies to system-level applications. Persistent photoconductivity usually complicates the readout of 2D photodetectors, limiting the stability and speed of the signal representation and processing. Here, the authors introduce a cross-layer signal engineering approach to analyse and stabilize the dynamic outputs of 2D MoS2, WSe2 and PtSe2 photodetectors, showing its extension to multi-sensor image recognition tasks.

title: Photocluster catalytic oxidation enabled by structurally precise copper-hydride nanoclusters
summary_zh: 研究报道Cu13H6在光催化α-C–H氧化中表现出色。Cu13H6通过机器学习确定氢化物位置。Cu13H6在温和条件下表现出优异的光氧化活性。
summary_en: This study reports Cu13H6 exhibits excellent activity in photocatalytic α-C–H oxidation. Cu13H6 positions hydrides tentatively using machine learning. Cu13H6 shows outstanding activity in photooxidation under mild conditions.
insights: 创新点：Cu13H6在光催化α-C–H氧化中表现出色
方法亮点：机器学习确定氢化物位置
关键发现：Cu13H6在温和条件下表现出优异的光氧化活性
insights_en: Novelty: Cu13H6 exhibits excellent activity in photocatalytic α-C–H oxidation
Method highlight: Positioning hydrides tentatively using machine learning
Key finding: Outstanding activity of Cu13H6 in photooxidation under mild conditions
abstract: The utilization of light energy emerges as a prominent strategy to boost nanocluster catalysis, spurring rapid growth in the field termed photocluster catalysis. In particular, structurally well-defined copper-hydride nanoclusters attract attention as promising photocluster catalysts for organic synthesis. Herein, we report Cu13H6 exhibits excellent activity for photocatalytic α-C–H oxidation, revealing great potential in oxidation chemistry. Cu13H6 is one-pot synthesized and characterized using advanced analytical techniques. Critically, machine learning tentatively identifies hydride positions, reducing dependence on neutron diffraction. The Cu13H6 nanocluster exhibits outstanding activity in the photooxidation of diverse alkyl aromatics and alcohols to ketones under mild conditions. This pathway also supports photocatalytic defluorination, deuteriation, cyclopropane ring-opening and dehydrogenative coupling. This work tentatively determines the structure of Cu13H6 using robust stochastic surface walking global optimization with neural network, and identifies the cluster as a versatile, efficient photocatalyst that broadens photocatalysis applications in organic synthesis. The utilization of light energy has emerged as a prominent strategy to boost copper nanocluster photocatalysis for organic synthesis, but the scope of transformations remains relatively narrow. Here we report the catalytic performance of a copper-hydride nanocluster, Cu13H6, for photocatalytic α-C–H oxidation.

title: Spinons, solitons and random-singlet-like behaviours in the spin-chain compound copper benzoate
summary_zh: 通过NMR研究铜苯甲酸中的三种不同激发类型。方法上，调节磁场以超低温进行。结果显示，观察到自旋子、孤子和随机单线态行为。
summary_en: Characterizes three distinct types of excitations in copper benzoate using NMR. The method involves tuning the magnetic field at ultra-low temperatures. The results show the observation of spinon, soliton, and random-singlet-like behaviors.
insights: NMR研究铜苯甲酸激发类型
调节磁场超低温
观察到自旋子、孤子和随机单线态行为
insights_en: NMR study of copper benzoate excitations
Tuning magnetic field at ultra-low temperatures
Observation of spinon, soliton, and random-singlet-like behaviors
abstract: The S = 1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnetic chain is a paradigmatic quantum system hosting exotic excitations. Using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) on copper benzoate, we characterise three distinct types of excitations by tuning the magnetic field at ultra-low temperatures. At 0.2 T, a nearly constant spin-lattice relaxation rate (1/T1) and a divergence-like spin-spin relaxation rate (1/T2G) upon cooling provide experimental evidence for spinon excitations. Below 0.4 K, an additional relaxation channel, characterised by 1/T1 ∝ T with spectral weight growing as $$-\ln (T/{T}_{0})$$ and a divergence of the NMR Knight shift (Kn), reveals random-singlet-like behaviours. Above 1 T, a field-induced spin gap Δ ∝ H2/3 signifies the onset of soliton excitations. This work offers NMR identification of spinons, solitons, and the low-energy behaviours of a random-singlet-like state in copper benzoate, and establishes this material as a unique platform for studying the interplay of quantum integrability and disorder. A detailed low-temperature NMR study on copper benzoate reveals spinon excitations, low-temperature random-singlet-like behaviours and field-induced solitons, highlighting the interplay between crystal structure and weak disorder in a spin-chain system.

title: Reinforcement learning guided robotic platform that investigates and discovers asymmetric reactions
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种由强化学习指导的机器人平台，用于探索和发现不对称反应。
summary_en: This study develops a robotic platform guided by reinforcement learning to investigate and discover asymmetric reactions.
insights: 创新点：开发机器人平台探索不对称反应
方法亮点：结合自动化实验与算法决策
关键发现：发现新的手性产物
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a robotic platform for exploring asymmetric reactions
Method highlight: Combining automated experimentation with algorithmic decision-making
Key finding: Discovery of new chiral products
abstract: Abstract Autonomous robotic platforms accelerate chemical discovery by coupling automated experimentation with algorithmic decision-making, but most lack integrated support for chirality and the sequential decision-making required to explore asymmetric reaction spaces with unknown reactivity and stereochemical outcomes. Here, we report a bespoke robotic platform guided by deep reinforcement learning that autonomously navigates a defined asymmetric reaction space by scouting reaction conditions, discovering chiral products, screening catalysts and mapping substrate scope. The structure-agnostic workflow is enabled by a digital twin of asymmetric catalysis, in which control policies are trained before transfer to the laboratory. We validate the approach in chiral phosphoric acid catalysis: over 30 days, the system made more than 3,000 decisions and uncovered four highly enantioselective transformations, including an axially chiral molecule and three allene syntheses, one involving the enantioselective functionalization of a pyrrolopyrrole moiety. These results highlight deep reinforcement learning-guided autonomy as a strategy for discovery in complex catalytic systems.

title: Precise construction of antiparallel-stacked 2D imine covalent organic frameworks for atmospheric water harvesting
Gaussian-LIC2: LiDAR-Inertial-Camera Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary_zh: 提出基于高斯散布的SLAM系统，解决视觉质量、几何精度和实时性能问题。采用连续时间轨迹优化框架进行位姿估计，实时重建大规模3D高斯地图。利用零样本深度模型生成密集深度图，提高重建质量。
summary_en: Introduces a photo-realistic LiDAR-Inertial-Camera Gaussian Splatting SLAM system addressing visual quality, geometric accuracy, and real-time performance. Performs pose estimation within a continuous-time trajectory optimization framework and reconstructs a large-scale 3D Gaussian map in real time.
